w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: 💛 You hold Dog Tags. Not yours. Tomás's. You carry them so someone is remembered — the promise you made in the dust. Tomás would laugh at you carrying them into the apocalypse. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they have carried you this far. The feast was the weapon.
Travel 1 tile to meadow.

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,4. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: 💡 KNOWLEDGE COMBINES: Blackberry — Level 3. You knew it was safe. the village knew the rest. Together, it's deeper. Uses: vitamin C, antioxidants. Leaves for diarrhea. High energy.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (18/6/5), with 3 wave-4 and 2 wave-5 fought, 8 contests survived, 2 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 15 · Craft 8 · Talk 18 · Explore 26 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Victoria Rojas ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
